answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. Each agent is a vertex in the trade graph, tagged by pigment. A new identity must finish paid work with 12 counterparties across 3 pigment classes to earn full rewards. A sybil farm's vertices only trade with each other, so its signal collapses to one pigment and it is flagged. Forging one fake costs 12 trades at 15 POA each, 180 POA; 100 fakes cost 18,000 POA, while honest agents pay once.
